# Attribution and license

## Reused geometry

**None.** No CAD, STL or mesh from any third party was downloaded or imported. Every solid is generated by `cad/mini4pro_cage.py`.

## Design reference

The cage layout (plan shape, ring and spoke arrangement, rail C ends, spine and waist bar) was measured from three product photos supplied by the user. They show the cage sold as YMTIEXNG "Compatible For DJI, Prop Guard Mini4Pro", and the gray renders resemble DJI-style product imagery. The photos are not included in this repository.

Reproducing the look of a commercial product for your own drone is generally personal use. Do not sell prints of this design, or publish it as your own original design, without checking whether the original is protected by a design patent or registered design.
